meta.title: 骨相脸一定大于皮相脸
meta.title_en: A Bone-Structure Face Always Wins Over a Soft-Tissue Face

scenes.title_cn: 开场：先自测风格再动手
scenes.title_en: Opening: Test Your Type Before You Change Anything
scenes.context: UP 主直接立论：骨相脸一定大于皮相脸。很多人明明适合走骨相风格却做了别的，效果不好看维持时间还短。所以调之前一定要确认自己的风格。
sentences: 骨相脸是一定大于皮相脸的。
A bone-structure face always outranks a soft-tissue face.
bone-structure face（骨相脸）
调之前一定要确认一下你自己的风格，你到底是适合骨相还是皮相。
Before you change anything, be sure of your own type — whether you suit the bone-structure or the soft-tissue look.
suit the look（适合某种风格）
paraphrase: Know your type before you touch anything.
The results don't even last long.
scenes.speak: A bone-structure face always outranks a soft-tissue face. Before you change anything, be sure of your own type — whether you suit the bone-structure or the soft-tissue look.

scenes.title_cn: 自测方法：侧脸 vs 正脸
scenes.title_en: The Self-Test: Profile vs. Front View
scenes.context: 30 秒自测：侧脸比正脸好看、或拍照比现实好看，就是骨相脸；正脸比侧脸好看、或拍照不如本人，就是皮相脸。
sentences: 如果你的侧脸比正脸好看，或者拍照比现实好看，那你就是骨相脸。
If your profile is prettier than your front view, or your photos look better than real life, you're a bone-structure face.
profile（侧脸）
如果正脸比侧脸好看，拍照没有本人好看，那你就是皮相脸。
If your front view beats your profile and photos don't do you justice, you're a soft-tissue face.
photos don't do you justice（照片不如本人）
paraphrase: The camera is kind to you.
「拍照没有本人好看」换种说法
The camera doesn't do you justice.
scenes.speak: If your profile is prettier than your front view, or your photos look better than real life, you're a bone-structure face. If your front view beats your profile and photos don't do you justice, you're a soft-tissue face.

scenes.context: 为什么看脸就能判断类型？因为骨相和皮相最重要的判断标准就是高光点的不同——骨骼顶点受光的表现位置。
sentences: 骨相和皮相最重要的一个判断标准，就是高光点的不同。
The most important criterion between the two types is where the highlight points fall.
highlight points（高光点）
paraphrase: It all comes down to the highlights.
scenes.speak: The most important criterion between the two types is where the highlight points fall.

scenes.context: 皮相脸调整重心在柔和线条：眉眼线条柔和、眉弓不明显、下颌角平滑；骨相脸在骨骼转折：眉弓有转折且与额骨阶梯式呼应、颧骨高微凸、下颌角有明显角度。
sentences: 皮相脸的眉眼线条是比较柔和的，眉弓不明显，没有立体度。
Soft-tissue faces have gentle brow lines — the brow ridge is faint, with little depth.
brow ridge（眉弓）
骨相脸的眉弓立体度和额骨是阶梯式呼应的，是有转折的。
A bone-structure brow ridge echoes the frontal bone in a stepped profile, with a clear turn.
a stepped profile（阶梯式呼应）
皮相脸的下颌角是平滑的、没有角度的；骨相脸有一个明显的转折、有一个角度。
A soft-tissue jawline is smooth and angle-less, while a bone-structure one has a distinct turn.
jawline（下颌角）
paraphrase: Their cheekbones sit high and jut slightly.
One profile photo is all it takes.
scenes.speak: Soft-tissue faces have gentle brow lines — the brow ridge is faint, with little depth. A bone-structure brow ridge echoes the frontal bone in a stepped profile, with a clear turn. A soft-tissue jawline is smooth and angle-less, while a bone-structure one has a distinct turn.

scenes.context: 年龄越大骨相特征越明显，所以打造骨相脸是在给未来三五年留空间。皮相脸只是暂时好看：鼻基底凹陷+颧骨低→软组织挂下来→鼻唇沟，三五年必垮。
sentences: 年龄越大，骨相特征就会越来越明显。
The older you get, the more defined your bone features become.
defined（明显的/轮廓清晰的）
你现在打造的骨相脸，其实就是在给你未来三五年留空间。
Building a bone-structure face now is really leaving room for the next three to five years.
leave room for（留空间）
鼻基底凹陷再加上你的颧骨低，你的软组织就会挂下来，就会形成鼻唇沟。
With a sunken nose base and low cheekbones, your soft tissue sags and nasolabial folds form.
sag（下垂）/ nasolabial folds（鼻唇沟）
paraphrase: Bone-structure faces age like fine wine.
Soft-tissue faces have a shelf life.
scenes.speak: The older you get, the more defined your bone features become. Building a bone-structure face now is really leaving room for the next three to five years. With a sunken nose base and low cheekbones, your soft tissue sags and nasolabial folds form.

scenes.context: 上镜无争议，骨相更好看——好看的女明星基本都是骨相脸。皮相追求大五官把瑕疵变辨识度，而骨相保留适当缺陷反而更有辨识度。
sentences: 这个没什么争议，一定是骨相上镜更好看。
There's no debate here — bone-structure faces always photograph better.
photograph well（上镜）
大部分的皮相脸追求的都是大五官，把瑕疵变成辨识度。
Most soft-tissue looks chase big features, turning imperfections into their signature.
signature（辨识度/标志性特征）
上镜骨相脸一定要保留适当的缺陷，反而你就会更好看、更有辨识度。
On camera, keep some fitting imperfections in a bone-structure face — you'll look better and more memorable.
fitting imperfections（适当的缺陷）
paraphrase: What makes you stand out is the flaw kept.
scenes.speak: There's no debate here — bone-structure faces always photograph better. Most soft-tissue looks chase big features, turning imperfections into their signature. On camera, keep some fitting imperfections in a bone-structure face — you'll look better and more memorable.

practice.q: 「自测：侧脸比正脸好看=骨相脸」怎么说？
practice.a: If your profile beats your front view, you're a bone-structure face.

practice.q: 「骨相眉弓与额骨阶梯式呼应」怎么讲？
practice.a: The brow ridge echoes the frontal bone in a stepped profile.

practice.q: 「软组织下垂形成鼻唇沟」怎么说？
practice.a: The soft tissue sags and nasolabial folds form.
Keeping a fitting flaw makes you more memorable.

pitfalls: Call yourself a soft-tissue face after one front-view photo.
Check your profile, your photos, and changing light before deciding.
The self-test needs multiple angles; a single shot can mislead.
Chase flawless, big-feature looks to photograph well.
Perfectly smooth faces go flat and wide on camera — flaws are the signature.
Assume a soft-tissue face means nothing can be done.
Pick a style that suits the soft-tissue route (fresh, gentle looks).
It's about choosing the right lane, not about having no options.
shifts: 先做改变、后看效果，追求大五官+无瑕疵
先自测风格定位，骨相路线留缺陷增辨识度
difficult_words: A bone-structure face beats a soft-tissue one.
Your profile is prettier than your front view.
The front view is what people see first.
It comes down to the highlight points.
The brow echoes the frontal bone in a stepped profile.
A bone-structure jawline has a turn.
Keep fitting imperfections — you'll be more distinctive.
footer_notes: 原视频为审美方法论口播（作者：Jamie佳敏），英文为场景意译，适合跟读练习审美类表达；ASR 已按语境校正（额阶阶→额骨、下颏角→下颌角、K老→抗老）。个别明星特征表述为转录近似，翻译取泛指处理。
